label: HARMLESS_REFACTOR
rationale: The commit deletes the single line `privé: oui` of the rule `dirigeant . auto-entrepreneur . cotisations et contributions . cotisations . taux ACRE`. In publicodes 1.10.4 `privé` is a visibility flag: it hides the rule (and its 6 descendants) from getParsedRules()/documentation, makes engine.evaluate() of it from outside fail ("n'est pas accessible depuis \"$EVALUATION\""), and forbids setting it in the situation ("est une règle privée"). No formula, constant, date or applicability condition changes. Build passes on both trees; the 69 existing checks plus the public-rule cells of 10 ACRE-specific checks give byte-identical values before and after (BNC ACRE 6 months at 01/07/2024 and 01/09/2024: service BNC . taux 10.6 %, cotisations 106 €/mois, CIPAV 12.1 %). What changes is the engine's public surface, not what any bounded rule computes: parsed_rule_count 1220 -> 1227, 7 rules become listable and evaluable (taux ACRE = 50 % for the first year, 12.1 % CIPAV constant, notification), and the rule can now be overridden from the situation. Law S4 is identical to S3 for all 12 bounded articles, and no bounded article states the ACRE micro-social rate: L613-7 I only enables "Un taux global différent peut être fixé par décret", D131-6-1 governs the 12-month exemption of classic travailleurs indépendants, so the 50 % / 12,10 % values that are now visible rest on a decree article outside the bounded set and on the Urssaf/service-public references cited in the rule; they are neither created nor altered by this commit. Pre-existing issues made more visible by the exposure (D613-4 b/e 23,2/23,1 % since 2024-07-01 vs 21,2/21,1 % in G1; taux ACRE . service BIC leaves the full 21,2 % under ACRE) are documented in notes, not attributed to this change. Approval: none recorded.

outside_bounded_set: The decree article fixing the different "taux global" for ACRE periods under L613-7 I (the source of the 50 % first-year rate, the 12,10 % CIPAV constant and the pre-04/2020 grids 25/75/90 and 25/50/90 %) is not in the bounded set; the rule cites Urssaf FAQ and service-public.fr F32318. Values therefore cannot be confirmed or refuted here (abstain).
L131-6-4 (ACRE eligibility, referenced by D131-6-1 and by `dirigeant . exonérations . ACRE`) is not in the bounded set.

The parent commit of 1932d654 (file blob a061b547e, re-indented to 2 spaces) is a pin later than G1 (blob 8914c3ae); the intermediate commits 2024-07-16 -> 2024-09-02 are not supplied, so before/after was measured as G1 vs G1-minus-this-line.
notes: Pre-existing, independent of this commit, visible in both trees: (1) D613-4 LEGIARTI000049624068 (in force 2024-07-01) gives b) 23,2 % and e) 23,1 % while G1 computes cotisations CIPAV . taux 21,2 % and service BNC . taux 21,1 % at 01/07/2024 (results_R2_before_T1a_rates.jsonl); the newly exposed taux ACRE . service BNC = 10,6 % = 50 % x 21,1 % therefore inherits that staleness (50 % x 23,1 % would be 11,55 %, but the 50 % itself is outside the bounded set, so no expected value is asserted). (2) `taux ACRE . service BIC` has `valeur: cotisations . service BIC . taux` without the `taux ACRE *` factor: an artisan/commercial service AE with ACRE (6 months, 1000 €/mois) pays service BIC . taux 21.2 % and cotisations 212 €/mois (missing 4) in both trees, whereas BNC and vente are halved (10,6 % / 6,2 %); whether the law requires 50 % for BIC depends on the decree article outside the bounded set. (3) Engine caveat: once taux ACRE's descendants are evaluable from outside, publicodes 1.10.4 returns an order-dependent value for a replaced rule in one measured case (see evidence); worth a regression test on the maintainers' side. Law S4 (legi-data 2.384.0, 2024-09-01) = S3 for all 12 articles (work/law/S4_index.json, S4_texts.md). The 1220 -> 1227 parsed-rule difference is exactly the 7 names listed after the change.
